project.name: Netbeans Plugin Kotlin Icons
project.description: Kotlin-specific completion icons (val, var, extension function, interface, enum, object, etc.) converted from IntelliJ IDEA SVG sources to 16x16 PNG at build time via Apache Batik. SVG sources come from submodules/IntellijCommunity (Apache License 2.0, Copyright 2000-2020 JetBrains s.r.o. and Kotlin Programming Language contributors).
